dogecoin.text: Dogecoin is the cryptocurrency the internet deserves. we were always destined to have a meme economy online.
my Dogecoin position has officially entered "ah shit, i'm gonna have to pay a meaningful amount of tax on this when i sell it" territory.
I want to live in world where Dogecoin replaced Bitcoin as the defacto "internet currency." Because that would be both hilarious and totally appropriate.
